findings.explanation: Toys/premium commission should be 17% of gross 5114.31 = 869.43 (plus 21.90 standard shipping), giving expected net 4222.98. Settlement row ST-0300021 charged fee -969.16 (net 4123.25), an excess commission of 99.73 with shipping correct.

Home/premium commission should be 17% of gross 2006.08 = 341.03 (plus 39.90 heavy shipping), giving expected net 1625.15. Settlement row ST-0300006 charged fee -400.21 (net 1565.97), an excess commission of 59.18 with shipping correct.

Order gross 64.74 (electronics/premium, low-ticket fee applies) should settle once: fee -16.61, net 48.13. Two payment rows (ST-0300026 and ST-0300057) each carry the full gross 64.74 and full fee -16.61, i.e. the entire payment was settled twice (not a legitimate split, since a split's second row should carry remaining gross with no fee). Observed total net 96.26 vs expected 48.13.
Delivered order (fashion/classic, gross 42.15, low-ticket fee applies) has zero settlement rows. Expected a payment row with fee -11.73 and net 30.42, but nothing was paid out.

Settlement row ST-0400068 (payment, gross 214.15, fee -27.84, net 186.31) references order MLB-049648, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding order to justify this payout, so the seller received/was credited money for an order that isn't on the books - a clawback risk.

Order MLB-040050 is weight_class 'heavy', so the contractual seller-paid shipping should be 39.90 (per rules section 2). The settlement row ST-0400057 deducted -61.80 in shipping instead, producing net 2463.96 vs expected 2485.86 (commission -517.32 matches in both). The extra 21.90 (61.80-39.90) was wrongly deducted from the seller.

Order MLB-040060 is weight_class 'standard', so the contractual seller-paid shipping should be 21.90. The settlement row ST-0400067 deducted -39.90 (the heavy rate) instead, producing net 754.69 vs expected 772.69 (commission -88.29 matches in both). The extra 18.00 (39.90-21.90) was wrongly deducted from the seller.

Order is fully refunded (gross 1211.46). Expected settlement: payment row net 1026.18 plus refund row gross -1211.46/fee +145.38/net -1066.08, totaling -39.90. Only the payment row (net 1026.18) is present; the refund row was never settled, leaving the seller with 1066.08 more than the expected net total of -39.90.

Delivered order (gross 909.36, premium/home/heavy) has zero settlement rows. Expected payment: commission 154.59 (17% of 909.36), shipping 39.90, net 714.87. Observed net is 0.00 - the entire settlement is missing.

Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled before payment), which per rule 6 must have no settlement rows at all. However a payment row exists: gross 363.23, fee -54.48, ship -21.90, net 286.85. Expected net is 0.00 (no rows), so the seller was paid out 286.85 on an order that should never have settled.

Full refund on a 38.40 low-ticket fashion order. Expected refund row: gross -38.40, fee +11.24 (commission returned), net -27.16, giving an overall expected net total of 0.00 across both rows. Observed refund row shows fee 0.00 (commission not returned), net -38.40, giving an overall net total of -11.24. The seller was shorted the 11.24 commission that should have been refunded back.

Premium toys order, gross 434.84, expected commission rate 17% = 73.92 (434.84*0.17), expected shipping 21.90, expected net 339.02. Observed fee is -82.62 (≈19% of gross) and net 330.32 - an overcharge of 8.70 in marketplace fee versus the contractual 17% premium/toys rate.

Partial refund (60% of gross, refund_amount=1158.25 on gross=1930.41) must return commission proportionally: commission on full order=308.87, so refund row should carry marketplace_fee=+185.32 (round_half_up(308.87*0.6)). Observed refund row ST-0600039 has fee=0.00. Expected net total=608.71 (payment 1581.64 + refund -972.93), observed net total=423.39 (1581.64 + -1158.25). Delta=-185.32.

Order is 'paid' status (fashion premium, gross=236.59, standard weight) with expected settlement net=172.10 (gross 236.59 - commission 42.59 - shipping 21.90), but there are zero settlement rows for this order at all.

Order MLB-060091 (books, gross=67.18, low-ticket fee applies) has two settlement rows ST-0600112 and ST-0600145, each carrying the FULL gross (67.18), FULL commission (-19.22) and FULL net (47.96) - this is not a legitimate split (which would put fees only on the first row and remaining gross with no fees on the second) but a straight duplicate of the same payment. Expected net=47.96, observed summed net=95.92, delta=+47.96 (double-paid).

Order MLB-060094 has weight_class='standard' (per order book), which per shipping rules should deduct 21.90 in shipping. Settlement row ST-0600114 deducted -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate) instead. Expected net=249.76 (308.70-37.04-21.90), observed net=231.76 (308.70-37.04-39.90), delta=-18.00.

Order MLB-060038 (electronics, premium, unit_price=36.18<79, qty=3) should charge commission=round(108.54*0.16)=17.37 plus low-ticket fee 6.25*3=18.75, total fee=-36.12, giving net=50.52. Settlement row ST-0600042 instead charged fee=-38.05, giving net=48.59. Overcharge=1.93.

Settlement row ST-0700194 (payment, gross 662.56, fee -86.13, net 576.43) references order MLB-079870, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No corresponding order means this settlement is unexplained/orphaned.

Order is 'delivered', gross 113.30, electronics/classic/standard shipping. Expected settlement: commission 11% = 12.46, shipping 21.90, net 78.94. No settlement rows exist for this order at all (observed net 0.00).

Order status is 'cancelled' (pre-payment cancellation per rules, which requires zero settlement rows), yet settlement row ST-0700195 shows a payment of gross 77.33, fee -19.40, net 57.93 was settled for this order.

Order is 'partially_refunded' with refund_amount 45.76 on gross 76.26 (fashion/classic, commission 13%+low-ticket fee, commission=16.16). Expected two lines: payment net 60.10 AND refund line gross -45.76, fee +9.70, net -36.06, giving expected total net 24.04. Only the payment row (net 60.10) was settled; the refund row was never generated, leaving the seller overpaid by 36.06.

Order MLB-070119 is weight_class 'heavy' (electronics/classic, gross 1756.35), which per rules requires a flat 39.90 shipping deduction (commission 193.20, expected net 1523.25). The settlement row instead deducted -61.80 in shipping (=39.90+21.90, apparently double-charged both heavy and standard shipping), producing net 1501.35 - a shortfall of 21.90 to the seller.

Order MLB-070003 is toys/premium, gross 244.74, correct commission rate is 17% = 41.61 (no low-ticket fee since unit price 122.37 >= 79). Expected net (with 21.90 standard shipping) = 181.23. Settlement row ST-0700003 instead charged a marketplace fee of -45.99 (effective ~18.8%), producing net 176.85 - an excess fee of 4.38.

Order gross 2602.59, expected a single payment row (fee -286.28, ship -39.90, net 2276.41). Instead two identical payment rows (ST-0800221, ST-0800233) each with full gross/fee/ship were settled, doubling the payout (observed net 4552.82 vs expected 2276.41). Not a legitimate split since both rows carry full fees/shipping.
Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled before payment), which per rules must have NO settlement rows. Yet payment row ST-0800232 was settled with gross 431.24, fee -73.31, ship -21.90, net 336.03.
Delivered order (fashion, classic, gross 130.24, low-ticket fee applies) expects one payment row: fee -29.43, ship -21.90, net 78.91. No settlement rows exist for this order at all.

Partial refund of 344.84 (30% of 1149.47) should return proportional commission: expected refund row gross -344.84, fee +41.38, net -303.46 (total order net 686.17). Observed refund row ST-0800023 has fee 0.00, net -344.84 (total observed net 644.79), so the 41.38 commission refund was never credited back to the seller.

Order weight_class is 'heavy', so shipping should be 39.90. Settlement row ST-0800078 deducted -61.80 instead, reducing net to 403.85 vs expected 425.75 (delta exactly the 21.90 excess shipping charge).

Fashion/premium commission rate is 18%: expected fee = round(734.75*0.18) = -132.26, expected net 580.59. Settlement row ST-0800128 charged fee -146.51 (net 566.34), an overcharge of 14.25 beyond the contractual rate.

Order status is 'refunded' for gross 3246.00. Rules require a refund row with gross=-3246.00, fee=+519.36, ship=0, net=-2726.64, giving expected total net of -39.90 (payment 2686.74 + refund -2726.64). Only the payment row (net 2686.74) appears on the statement; the refund row is missing entirely.

Order gross 521.19 (fashion/premium) should generate one payment row net 405.48 (fee -93.81, ship -21.90). Two identical rows appear (ST-0900109 and ST-0900297), each carrying the full fee and shipping (-93.81/-21.90), summing to net 810.96 instead of 405.48. A legitimate split would carry fees only on the first row; here both rows duplicate the full fee/shipping, indicating the payment was settled twice.

Settlement row ST-0900298 (payment, gross 425.56, fee -55.32, net 370.24) references order MLB-099824, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding order to justify this settlement.

Order MLB-090238 (home/classic, gross 229.44, unit 76.48<79 triggers low-ticket fee) is in 'paid' status and should have a payment row of gross 229.44, fee -46.28 (12% commission + 6.25*3 low-ticket fee), ship -21.90, net 161.26. No settlement rows exist for this order at all.

Order MLB-090087 (home/classic, gross 2272.51) should be charged 12% commission = 272.70 (round_half_up(2272.51*0.12)). The observed settlement row ST-0900105 charges fee -335.42, i.e. 62.72 more than the correct commission, reducing net from expected 1959.91 to observed 1897.19.

Order MLB-090036 (home/premium, gross 2303.40) should be charged 17% commission = 391.58 (round_half_up(2303.40*0.17)). The observed settlement row ST-0900046 charges fee -442.95, i.e. 51.37 more than the correct commission, reducing net from expected 1871.92 to observed 1820.55.

Order MLB-090243 has weight_class 'standard', so the correct seller-paid shipping is 21.90. The settlement row ST-0900288 deducts -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate) instead, reducing net from expected 2056.16 to observed 2038.16, a difference of exactly 18.00 (39.90-21.90).

Settlement row ST-1000340 (payment, gross 661.91, fee -86.05, net 575.86) exists on the statement but order MLB-109378 does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No expected settlement can be derived (expected=0.00), so the full observed net of 575.86 is an unexplained/unmatched credit that will likely be clawed back.

Order MLB-100150 (status paid, home/classic, heavy, gross 419.68) has zero settlement rows, but per rules expects commission 12% = 50.36 and heavy shipping 39.90, giving expected net 329.42. Seller received nothing for a paid order.

Order MLB-100045 has status 'cancelled', which per rule 6 must have NO settlement rows, yet a payment row (ST-1000339, gross 52.58, fee -11.51, net 41.07) was settled. Seller received 41.07 it is not entitled to.

Order MLB-100069 has weight_class 'standard', which should incur shipping of 21.90 (expected net 336.81 with fee -73.47, ship -21.90). The settlement row (ST-1000075) instead deducted 39.90 (the 'heavy' rate), producing net 318.81 - an 18.00 excess shipping deduction.

Order MLB-100060 (books/premium, gross 74.56, fully refunded) should have a refund row returning the commission: expected refund gross -74.56, fee +17.43, net -57.13 (total order net 0.00). Observed refund row ST-1000066 has fee 0.00, net -74.56, so the 17.43 commission was never returned to the seller, leaving an order net of -17.43 instead of 0.00.

Order MLB-100168 (fashion/premium, gross 406.02) should be charged commission at 18% = 73.08 (no low-ticket fee since unit_price>79), giving expected net 311.04 (fee -73.08, ship -21.90). Observed settlement ST-1000185 charged fee -84.49 (net 299.63), an excess commission charge of 11.41 with shipping correct at -21.90.

Order MLB-100300 (fashion/premium, gross 17.83, status refunded) has only the original payment row settled (gross 17.83, fee -9.46, net 8.37) matching the expected payment leg, but the required refund row (expected gross -17.83, fee +9.46, net -8.37, bringing order total to 0.00) is completely absent from the statement. Seller retains the full 8.37 net despite the order being refunded to the buyer.

Order status is 'cancelled' (home/heavy, gross 1465.32). Per rule #6, cancelled orders must have NO settlement rows. However settlement row ST-1100398 posted a full payment (gross 1465.32, fee -175.84, ship -39.90, net 1249.58). Expected net was 0.00, observed was 1249.58.
Order is 'paid' (toys/classic, gross 811.30, standard shipping). Expected settlement: fee -97.36 (12% commission), ship -21.90, net 692.04. No settlement rows exist at all for this order.

Order (electronics/classic, gross 272.00) expects one payment row: fee -29.92, ship -21.90, net 220.18. Two identical payment rows were posted (ST-1100368 and ST-1100397), each with full gross 272.00, fee -29.92, ship -21.90 (net 220.18 each), summing to net 440.36. This is not a legitimate split (a split carries fees only on the first row and no-fee remaining gross on the second) - both rows duplicate the full fee and gross.

Order is 'partially_refunded' with refund_amount 240.13 (home/premium, gross 1200.66). Expected lines: payment net 956.65 plus refund line gross -240.13, fee +40.82, net -199.31, giving expected total net 757.34. Only the payment row (net 956.65) was settled; the refund row is missing entirely, leaving the seller holding the refunded amount.

Order is electronics/premium, gross 1581.29, expected commission rate 16% => fee -253.01 (net 1288.38 after -39.90 shipping). Observed settlement row ST-1100185 charged fee -295.70 (net 1245.69), an overcharge of 42.69 versus the contractual rate.

Order is fashion/premium, weight_class 'standard', gross 1925.44 >=79 so seller-paid shipping should be 21.90 (standard rate), giving expected net 1556.96 (fee -346.58, ship -21.90). Observed row ST-1100296 deducted ship -39.90 (heavy rate) instead, net 1538.96, an 18.00 over-deduction.

Order is books/premium, partially refunded 101.55 on gross 203.09 (commission 15%, fee -30.46 on payment). Expected refund row: gross -101.55, fee +15.23 (commission returned proportionally), net -86.32. Observed refund row ST-1100109 has fee 0.00, net -101.55 - the commission portion (15.23) was never returned to the seller.
Order is 'paid' with gross 1482.47 (home/classic/heavy) but has zero settlement rows. Expected net per calc_expected is 1264.67, observed net is 0.00.

A payment settlement row (gross 454.05, fee -59.03, net 395.02) exists on the statement for order MLB-129910, which does not appear anywhere in the seller's order book. Seller received 395.02 for an order that doesn't exist on their side.

Partial refund of 20% (refund_amount 1233.56 on gross 6167.82). Rule requires the refund row to return commission*20% = 801.82*0.2 = 160.36 as a positive marketplace_fee, giving expected refund net -1073.20. Observed refund row has fee=0.00 and net=-1233.56, i.e. the commission was never returned. Total expected net 4270.90 vs observed 4110.54, delta 160.36.

Order status is 'cancelled' (gross 217.59, electronics/classic/standard). Per rules, cancelled orders must have NO settlement rows. A payment row was nonetheless settled: gross 217.59, fee -42.68, ship -21.90, net 153.01.

Order status is 'refunded' (full refund, gross 151.73, books/classic). Expected settlement is a payment row (net 114.66) plus a refund row (gross -151.73, fee +15.17, net -136.56), for an expected total net of -21.90. Only the payment row (net 114.66) was settled; no refund row exists at all. Seller currently retains 114.66 instead of the contractually correct -21.90, a difference of 136.56.

Order is a single sale (gross 78.41, electronics/premium, low-ticket fee applies). Expected is one payment row with net 59.61. The statement shows two identical payment rows (ST-1200056 and ST-1200460), each gross 78.41/fee -18.80/net 59.61, summing to net 119.22 - double the expected amount.

Order weight_class is 'standard', so shipping should be 21.90, giving expected net 321.10 (gross 385.39, fee -42.39, ship -21.90). The settlement instead deducted the 'heavy' rate of 39.90, producing observed net 303.10 - a shortfall of 18.00.

Order weight_class is 'standard' (fashion/classic, gross 591.18), so shipping should be 21.90, giving expected net 492.43 (fee -76.85, ship -21.90). The settlement deducted the heavy rate of 39.90 instead, producing observed net 474.43 - a shortfall of 18.00.

Order is toys/classic, gross 630.17, so commission should be 12% = 75.62 (unit price >=79, no low-ticket fee), giving expected net 532.65 (with ship -21.90). The settlement charged fee -85.20 (effective ~13.52%), producing observed net 523.07 - a shortfall of 9.58.

Order is books/classic, gross 343.59, so commission should be 10% = 34.36, giving expected net 287.33 (with ship -21.90). The settlement charged fee -41.64 (effective ~12.12%), producing observed net 280.05 - a shortfall of 7.28.
